items.question: Trong câu "In an interview nobody tells you which tool to use — you have to infer it from the problem.", từ "infer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In an interview nobody tells you which tool to use — you have to infer it from the problem.", what does "infer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: infer /ɪnˈfɜːr/ (động từ): suy ra. "Infer something from something" = suy ra điều gì từ dữ kiện nào; ở đây là tự đoán công cụ phù hợp từ đề bài.
items.explanationEn: infer /ɪnˈfɜːr/ (verb): to work out from clues. "Infer something from something" means to conclude it from evidence; here you work out the right tool from the problem.

items.question: Trong câu "The first and most underrated clue is the input size.", từ "underrated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first and most underrated clue is the input size.", what does "underrated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underrated /ˌʌndəˈreɪtɪd/ (tính từ): bị đánh giá thấp. Trái nghĩa là "overrated" (được đánh giá quá cao); "the most underrated clue" = gợi ý bị xem nhẹ nhất.
items.explanationEn: underrated /ˌʌndəˈreɪtɪd/ (adjective): valued less than it deserves. The opposite is "overrated"; "the most underrated clue" is the hint people pay least attention to.

items.question: Trong câu "The first and most underrated clue is the input size.", từ "clue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first and most underrated clue is the input size.", what does "clue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: clue /kluː/ (danh từ): manh mối, gợi ý. Cụm hay gặp: "give a clue" (đưa gợi ý), "have no clue" (không biết gì cả).
items.explanationEn: clue /kluː/ (noun): a hint toward an answer. Common phrases: "give a clue" (offer a hint), "have no clue" (have no idea at all).

items.question: Trong câu "A modern machine does roughly 10⁸ simple operations per second, and online judges usually allow 1–2 seconds.", từ "roughly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A modern machine does roughly 10⁸ simple operations per second, and online judges usually allow 1–2 seconds.", what does "roughly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: roughly /ˈrʌfli/ (trạng từ): khoảng chừng. "Roughly" đứng trước con số để chỉ ước lượng, giống "about"; nghĩa khác là "một cách thô bạo".
items.explanationEn: roughly /ˈrʌfli/ (adverb): approximately. "Roughly" before a number marks an estimate, like "about"; its other sense is "in a harsh or violent way".

items.question: Trong câu "Working backwards from n gives you a target complexity before you write a line:", từ "work backwards" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Working backwards from n gives you a target complexity before you write a line:", what does "work backwards" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to work at a slower pace
to reason from the end back
items.explanation: work backwards /wɜːk ˈbækwədz/ (cụm từ): suy ngược từ kết quả. "Work backwards from X" = bắt đầu từ X (giới hạn đầu vào) rồi suy ra độ phức tạp cần đạt.
items.explanationEn: work backwards /wɜːk ˈbækwədz/ (phrase): to reason from the end back. "Work backwards from X" means starting at X (the input limit) and deducing the complexity you need.

items.question: Trong câu "The second clue is the shape of the input (sorted? a grid? a tree? pairs of dependencies?) and the third is the question being asked (count, minimum, all combinations, yes/no).", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The second clue is the shape of the input (sorted? a grid? a tree? pairs of dependencies?) and the third is the question being asked (count, minimum, all combinations, yes/no).", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an extra section of a book
a thing that relies on another
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): sự phụ thuộc. "Pairs of dependencies" (cặp phụ thuộc, A phải làm trước B) là dấu hiệu của sắp xếp tô-pô.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): a thing that relies on another. "Pairs of dependencies" (A must come before B) are a signal for topological sort.

items.question: Trong câu "Everything else is secondary.", từ "secondary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Everything else is secondary.", what does "secondary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: secondary /ˈsekəndri/ (tính từ): thứ yếu. "X is secondary" = X không quan trọng bằng điều chính; nghĩa khác: "secondary school" (trường trung học).
items.explanationEn: secondary /ˈsekəndri/ (adjective): less important. "X is secondary" means X matters less than the main point; another sense is "secondary school".

items.question: Trong câu "Common trade-offs worth saying out loud:", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common trade-offs worth saying out loud:", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: giving up one gain for another
a swap of one item for another
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. Cụm hay gặp: "a trade-off between speed and memory" (đánh đổi giữa tốc độ và bộ nhớ).
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ (noun): giving up one gain for another. Common pattern: "a trade-off between speed and memory".

items.question: Trong câu "Common trade-offs worth saying out loud:", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common trade-offs worth saying out loud:", what does "out loud" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (cụm từ): thành tiếng. "Say/think out loud" = nói ra thành tiếng; trong phỏng vấn nên "think out loud" để người phỏng vấn theo dõi.
items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): aloud, so others hear. "Say/think out loud" means speaking so others can hear; in interviews you should think out loud.

items.question: Trong câu "hash map is O(1) average but unordered", từ "unordered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "hash map is O(1) average but unordered", what does "unordered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unordered /ʌnˈɔːdəd/ (tính từ): không có thứ tự. "Unordered" = các khóa không được giữ theo thứ tự; trái nghĩa "ordered/sorted".
items.explanationEn: unordered /ʌnˈɔːdəd/ (adjective): kept in no fixed order. "Unordered" means the keys are not kept in any sequence; the opposite is "ordered" or "sorted".

items.question: Trong câu "list uses O(V + E) space and suits sparse graphs", từ "sparse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "list uses O(V + E) space and suits sparse graphs", what does "sparse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sparse /spɑːs/ (tính từ): thưa thớt. "Sparse graph" = đồ thị thưa (ít cạnh); trái nghĩa là "dense graph" (đồ thị dày).
items.explanationEn: sparse /spɑːs/ (adjective): having few items spread out. A "sparse graph" has few edges; the opposite is a "dense graph".

items.question: Trong câu "a heap gives O(log n) insert and O(1) peek at the extreme; keeping an array sorted costs O(n) per insert.", từ "extreme" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a heap gives O(log n) insert and O(1) peek at the extreme; keeping an array sorted costs O(n) per insert.", what does "extreme" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (danh từ): giá trị cực trị. "The extreme" ở đây là phần tử nhỏ nhất hoặc lớn nhất của heap; cụm khác: "go to extremes" (làm quá mức).
items.explanationEn: extreme /ɪkˈstriːm/ (noun): the highest or lowest value. Here "the extreme" is the heap's min or max; another phrase is "go to extremes" (act too far).

items.question: Trong câu "a heap gives O(log n) insert and O(1) peek at the extreme; keeping an array sorted costs O(n) per insert.", từ "peek" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a heap gives O(log n) insert and O(1) peek at the extreme; keeping an array sorted costs O(n) per insert.", what does "peek" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: peek /piːk/ (danh từ): cái nhìn lướt. "Peek" = xem phần tử trên cùng mà không lấy ra; đừng nhầm với "peak" (đỉnh) phát âm giống hệt.
items.explanationEn: peek /piːk/ (noun): a quick look. "Peek" means looking at the top item without removing it; do not confuse it with "peak", which sounds the same.

items.question: Trong câu "Most interview problems are a known pattern in disguise.", từ "in disguise" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most interview problems are a known pattern in disguise.", what does "in disguise" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in disguise /ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz/ (cụm từ): đội lốt, trá hình. "X in disguise" = X ẩn dưới vẻ ngoài khác; thành ngữ "a blessing in disguise" (trong cái rủi có cái may).
items.explanationEn: in disguise /ɪn dɪsˈɡaɪz/ (phrase): hidden under another look. "X in disguise" means X hidden behind another appearance; idiom: "a blessing in disguise".

items.question: Trong câu "Learn to map signals to patterns:", từ "signal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Learn to map signals to patterns:", what does "signal" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that points to something
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu. "Signals in the problem" = những dấu hiệu trong đề bài gợi ý pattern nên dùng.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡnəl/ (noun): a sign that points to something. "Signals in the problem" are the hints in the statement that suggest which pattern to use.

items.question: Trong câu "Learn to map signals to patterns:", từ "map" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Learn to map signals to patterns:", what does "map" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to draw a chart of land
to link each item to a match
items.explanation: map /mæp/ (động từ): gắn tương ứng. "Map A to B" = ánh xạ / gắn A với B tương ứng; cùng gốc với cấu trúc Map (khóa → giá trị).
items.explanationEn: map /mæp/ (verb): to link each item to a match. "Map A to B" means to pair each A with a matching B; same idea as a Map (key to value).

items.question: Trong câu "The table is a starting point, not a proof: always check the pattern actually fits (for example, sliding window needs the window's validity to change monotonically as it grows).", từ "monotonically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The table is a starting point, not a proof: always check the pattern actually fits (for example, sliding window needs the window's validity to change monotonically as it grows).", what does "monotonically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: monotonically /ˌmɒnəˈtɒnɪkli/ (trạng từ): chỉ theo một chiều. Trong toán, "change monotonically" = chỉ tăng hoặc chỉ giảm, không đổi chiều; nghĩa đời thường là "đều đều, buồn tẻ".
items.explanationEn: monotonically /ˌmɒnəˈtɒnɪkli/ (adverb): only rising or only falling. In maths, "change monotonically" means only going up or only going down; in daily speech it means "dully, without variation".

items.question: Trong câu "The table is a starting point, not a proof: always check the pattern actually fits (for example, sliding window needs the window's validity to change monotonically as it grows).", từ "proof" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The table is a starting point, not a proof: always check the pattern actually fits (for example, sliding window needs the window's validity to change monotonically as it grows).", what does "proof" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: something showing a claim is true
items.explanation: proof /pruːf/ (danh từ): sự chứng minh. "Not a proof" = không phải là chứng minh chắc chắn; "proof of correctness" = chứng minh tính đúng.
items.explanationEn: proof /pruːf/ (noun): something showing a claim is true. "Not a proof" means it does not guarantee correctness; "proof of correctness" shows an algorithm is right.

items.question: Trong câu "The table is a starting point, not a proof: always check the pattern actually fits (for example, sliding window needs the window's validity to change monotonically as it grows).", từ "validity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The table is a starting point, not a proof: always check the pattern actually fits (for example, sliding window needs the window's validity to change monotonically as it grows).", what does "validity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: validity /vəˈlɪdəti/ (danh từ): tính hợp lệ. Danh từ của "valid" (hợp lệ); "the window's validity" = cửa sổ hiện tại có thỏa điều kiện hay không.
items.explanationEn: validity /vəˈlɪdəti/ (noun): the state of being acceptable. Noun of "valid"; "the window's validity" is whether the current window meets the condition.

items.question: Trong câu "Two pointers on a sorted array — move whichever pointer brings the sum closer to the target:", từ "target" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two pointers on a sorted array — move whichever pointer brings the sum closer to the target:", what does "target" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the value you aim to reach
items.explanation: target /ˈtɑːɡɪt/ (danh từ): giá trị đích. "Close to the target" = gần giá trị cần tìm; "target sum" = tổng mục tiêu.
items.explanationEn: target /ˈtɑːɡɪt/ (noun): the value you aim to reach. "Close to the target" means near the value being sought; "target sum" is the sum you want.

items.question: Trong câu "Sliding window — grow the right edge, shrink the left edge when the window becomes invalid:", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sliding window — grow the right edge, shrink the left edge when the window becomes invalid:", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): thu hẹp lại. Cặp đối nghĩa trong sliding window: "grow" (mở rộng) và "shrink" (thu hẹp); dạng quá khứ: shrank, shrunk.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to make smaller. Sliding window pairs "grow" with "shrink"; past forms: shrank, shrunk.

items.question: Trong câu "Sliding window — grow the right edge, shrink the left edge when the window becomes invalid:", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sliding window — grow the right edge, shrink the left edge when the window becomes invalid:", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): mép, biên. "The left/right edge" = biên trái/phải của cửa sổ; nghĩa khác "have an edge" = có lợi thế; trong đồ thị "edge" là cạnh.
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): the outer boundary. "The left/right edge" is the window boundary; "have an edge" means an advantage; in graphs an "edge" links two nodes.

items.question: Trong câu "Sliding window — grow the right edge, shrink the left edge when the window becomes invalid:", từ "invalid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sliding window — grow the right edge, shrink the left edge when the window becomes invalid:", what does "invalid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: invalid /ɪnˈvælɪd/ (tính từ): không hợp lệ. "Become invalid" = trở nên không hợp lệ (vi phạm điều kiện), lúc đó cần thu hẹp cửa sổ.
items.explanationEn: invalid /ɪnˈvælɪd/ (adjective): not acceptable under the rules. "Become invalid" means the window breaks the condition, which is when you shrink it.

items.question: Trong câu "Each index enters and leaves the window at most once, so the total work is O(n) even though there are two moving edges.", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each index enters and leaves the window at most once, so the total work is O(n) even though there are two moving edges.", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /æt məʊst/ (cụm từ): tối đa. "At most once" = nhiều nhất một lần; trái nghĩa "at least once" (ít nhất một lần).
items.explanationEn: at most /æt məʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most once" means no more than one time; the opposite is "at least once".

items.question: Trong câu "Each index enters and leaves the window at most once, so the total work is O(n) even though there are two moving edges.", từ "even though" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each index enters and leaves the window at most once, so the total work is O(n) even though there are two moving edges.", what does "even though" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: even though /ˈiːvn ðəʊ/ (liên từ): mặc dù. "Even though" nhấn mạnh sự tương phản mạnh hơn "although"; theo sau là một mệnh đề đầy đủ.
items.explanationEn: even though /ˈiːvn ðəʊ/ (conjunction): despite the fact that. "Even though" stresses contrast more than "although" and is followed by a full clause.

items.question: Trong câu "Prefix sums — precompute once, answer any range sum in O(1):", từ "precompute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prefix sums — precompute once, answer any range sum in O(1):", what does "precompute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: precompute /ˌpriːkəmˈpjuːt/ (động từ): tính trước. Tiền tố "pre-" = trước; "precompute once" = tính một lần từ trước để trả lời truy vấn nhanh.
items.explanationEn: precompute /ˌpriːkəmˈpjuːt/ (verb): to calculate in advance. The prefix "pre-" means before; "precompute once" means doing the work up front so queries are fast.

items.question: Trong câu "A hash map trades O(n) space for O(1) average lookups, and it is the single most common way to turn O(n²) into O(n).", từ "trade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A hash map trades O(n) space for O(1) average lookups, and it is the single most common way to turn O(n²) into O(n).", what does "trade" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give one thing for another
items.explanation: trade /treɪd/ (động từ): đổi lấy. "Trade X for Y" = bỏ ra X để được Y; ở đây tốn thêm bộ nhớ để tra cứu nhanh hơn.
items.explanationEn: trade /treɪd/ (verb): to give one thing for another. "Trade X for Y" means giving up X to gain Y; here extra memory buys faster lookups.

items.question: Trong câu "A hash map trades O(n) space for O(1) average lookups, and it is the single most common way to turn O(n²) into O(n).", từ "lookup" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A hash map trades O(n) space for O(1) average lookups, and it is the single most common way to turn O(n²) into O(n).", what does "lookup" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an act of finding a value
items.explanation: lookup /ˈlʊkʌp/ (danh từ): lần tra cứu. Danh từ "lookup" viết liền; động từ là "look up" (tra cứu) viết rời.
items.explanationEn: lookup /ˈlʊkʌp/ (noun): an act of finding a value. The noun "lookup" is one word; the verb is "look up", written as two words.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic is Two Sum on an unsorted array:", từ "classic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic is Two Sum on an unsorted array:", what does "classic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (danh từ): ví dụ kinh điển. "The classic" = bài/ví dụ kinh điển ai cũng biết; cũng dùng làm tính từ: "a classic problem".
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (noun): a well-known standard example. "The classic" is the example everyone knows; it also works as an adjective: "a classic problem".

items.question: Trong câu "Binary search on the answer is binary search applied not to an array but to a range of possible answers.", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Binary search on the answer is binary search applied not to an array but to a range of possible answers.", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): áp dụng. "Apply X to Y" = áp dụng X lên Y; "apply for a job" lại là nộp đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to use on something. "Apply X to Y" means to use X on Y; "apply for a job" means to submit a request.

items.question: Trong câu "It works whenever "answer x is feasible" is monotonic: if x works, every larger x works too.", từ "feasible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It works whenever "answer x is feasible" is monotonic: if x works, every larger x works too.", what does "feasible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: feasible /ˈfiːzəbl/ (tính từ): khả thi. "A feasible solution" = lời giải khả thi (thỏa điều kiện), chưa chắc là tối ưu.
items.explanationEn: feasible /ˈfiːzəbl/ (adjective): possible to achieve. "A feasible solution" meets the conditions but is not necessarily the best one.

items.question: Trong câu "It works whenever "answer x is feasible" is monotonic: if x works, every larger x works too.", từ "whenever" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It works whenever "answer x is feasible" is monotonic: if x works, every larger x works too.", what does "whenever" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: whenever /wenˈevə/ (liên từ): bất cứ khi nào. "Whenever + mệnh đề" = mỗi khi điều kiện đúng; đừng nhầm với "wherever" (bất cứ nơi đâu).
items.explanationEn: whenever /wenˈevə/ (conjunction): at any time that. "Whenever + clause" means each time the condition holds; do not confuse it with "wherever".

items.question: Trong câu "Keep a min-heap of size k: push each item, and if the heap grows past k, pop the smallest.", từ "past" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep a min-heap of size k: push each item, and if the heap grows past k, pop the smallest.", what does "past" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: past /pɑːst/ (giới từ): vượt quá. "Grow past k" = lớn vượt quá k; "past" còn là danh từ "quá khứ" (in the past).
items.explanationEn: past /pɑːst/ (preposition): beyond a limit. "Grow past k" means become larger than k; "past" is also a noun meaning an earlier time.

items.question: Trong câu "What remains are the k largest.", từ "remain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What remains are the k largest.", what does "remain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: remain /rɪˈmeɪn/ (động từ): còn lại. "What remains" = những gì còn lại; danh từ "the remainder" = phần còn lại / số dư.
items.explanationEn: remain /rɪˈmeɪn/ (verb): to be left over. "What remains" means what is left; the noun "remainder" means the rest or a division leftover.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript has no built-in heap, so in an interview either write a compact array-based heap (bubble up / sink down) or state that you would use one and focus on the logic.", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript has no built-in heap, so in an interview either write a compact array-based heap (bubble up / sink down) or state that you would use one and focus on the logic.", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪlt ˈɪn/ (tính từ): có sẵn. "Built-in" = tích hợp sẵn trong ngôn ngữ; ví dụ "built-in functions" (hàm có sẵn).
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪlt ˈɪn/ (adjective): included as standard. "Built-in" means provided by the language itself, as in "built-in functions".

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript has no built-in heap, so in an interview either write a compact array-based heap (bubble up / sink down) or state that you would use one and focus on the logic.", từ "compact" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript has no built-in heap, so in an interview either write a compact array-based heap (bubble up / sink down) or state that you would use one and focus on the logic.", what does "compact" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (tính từ): gọn nhẹ. "A compact implementation" = cài đặt ngắn gọn; "compact car" = xe cỡ nhỏ.
items.explanationEn: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (adjective): small and neatly made. "A compact implementation" is short and tidy; a "compact car" is a small car.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript has no built-in heap, so in an interview either write a compact array-based heap (bubble up / sink down) or state that you would use one and focus on the logic.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript has no built-in heap, so in an interview either write a compact array-based heap (bubble up / sink down) or state that you would use one and focus on the logic.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ. "State that..." = phát biểu rõ rằng...; danh từ "state" lại là "trạng thái" hoặc "bang".
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State that..." means to say something clearly; the noun "state" means a condition or a region.

items.question: Trong câu "Intervals almost always start with sorting by start time, then a single sweep:", từ "sweep" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Intervals almost always start with sorting by start time, then a single sweep:", what does "sweep" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sweep /swiːp/ (danh từ): lượt quét qua. "A single sweep" = một lượt duyệt từ trái sang phải; "sweep line" là kỹ thuật đường quét.
items.explanationEn: sweep /swiːp/ (noun): one pass over all items. "A single sweep" is one left-to-right pass; "sweep line" is the name of the technique.

items.question: Trong câu "Intervals almost always start with sorting by start time, then a single sweep:", từ "interval" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Intervals almost always start with sorting by start time, then a single sweep:", what does "interval" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a span from start to end
items.explanation: interval /ˈɪntəvl/ (danh từ): khoảng (đầu–cuối). "Overlapping intervals" = các khoảng chồng lấn; "at regular intervals" = đều đặn theo khoảng thời gian.
items.explanationEn: interval /ˈɪntəvl/ (noun): a span from start to end. "Overlapping intervals" share some range; "at regular intervals" means at even time gaps.

items.question: Trong câu "On trees, BFS holds up to a whole level in the queue (O(w), wide trees hurt), while DFS holds one root-to-leaf path on the stack (O(h), deep trees hurt).", từ "up to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On trees, BFS holds up to a whole level in the queue (O(w), wide trees hurt), while DFS holds one root-to-leaf path on the stack (O(h), deep trees hurt).", what does "up to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up to /ʌp tuː/ (cụm từ): nhiều nhất là. "Up to + số lượng" = tối đa đến; "It's up to you" lại nghĩa là "tùy bạn".
items.explanationEn: up to /ʌp tuː/ (phrase): as many as. "Up to + amount" means as much as; "it's up to you" means "you decide".

items.question: Trong câu "A grid is a graph in disguise — each cell is a vertex with up to four edges.", từ "vertex" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A grid is a graph in disguise — each cell is a vertex with up to four edges.", what does "vertex" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vertex /ˈvɜːteks/ (danh từ): đỉnh (của đồ thị). Số nhiều bất quy tắc: "vertices" /ˈvɜːtɪsiːz/; V trong O(V + E) là số đỉnh.
items.explanationEn: vertex /ˈvɜːteks/ (noun): a point where edges meet. Irregular plural: "vertices"; V in O(V + E) is the number of vertices.

items.question: Trong câu "A grid is a graph in disguise — each cell is a vertex with up to four edges.", từ "cell" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A grid is a graph in disguise — each cell is a vertex with up to four edges.", what does "cell" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cell /sel/ (danh từ): ô (lưới, bảng). "A cell in a grid/table" = một ô; nghĩa khác: tế bào sinh học, phòng giam, pin (battery cell).
items.explanationEn: cell /sel/ (noun): one box in a grid. "A cell in a grid/table" is one box; other senses include a biological cell and a prison room.

items.question: Trong câu "Backtracking template — choose, explore, un-choose:", từ "template" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backtracking template — choose, explore, un-choose:", what does "template" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: template /ˈtempleɪt/ (danh từ): khuôn mẫu. "A BFS/backtracking template" = khung code mẫu dùng lại cho nhiều bài; đừng nhầm với "temple".
items.explanationEn: template /ˈtempleɪt/ (noun): a reusable pattern to copy. A "BFS/backtracking template" is skeleton code reused across problems; do not confuse it with "temple".

items.question: Trong câu "Backtracking template — choose, explore, un-choose:", từ "explore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Backtracking template — choose, explore, un-choose:", what does "explore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: explore /ɪkˈsplɔː/ (động từ): khám phá, thử đi tiếp. Trong backtracking, "explore" = đi sâu vào nhánh vừa chọn; dễ nhầm với "explode", "export", "explain".
items.explanationEn: explore /ɪkˈsplɔː/ (verb): to investigate a path. In backtracking, "explore" means going deeper down the chosen branch; do not mix it up with "explode" or "export".

items.question: Trong câu "Mark a cell as visited when you enqueue it, not when you dequeue it — otherwise the same cell can be enqueued many times.", từ "enqueue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mark a cell as visited when you enqueue it, not when you dequeue it — otherwise the same cell can be enqueued many times.", what does "enqueue" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a new order
items.explanation: enqueue /ɪnˈkjuː/ (động từ): đưa vào hàng đợi. Cặp đối nghĩa: "enqueue" (thêm vào cuối hàng đợi) và "dequeue" (lấy ra ở đầu).
items.explanationEn: enqueue /ɪnˈkjuː/ (verb): to add to a queue. The pair is "enqueue" (add at the back) and "dequeue" (remove from the front).

items.question: Trong câu "Mark a cell as visited when you enqueue it, not when you dequeue it — otherwise the same cell can be enqueued many times.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mark a cell as visited when you enqueue it, not when you dequeue it — otherwise the same cell can be enqueued many times.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Otherwise" nêu hậu quả nếu không làm theo điều vừa nói; nghĩa khác: "theo cách khác".
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌðəwaɪz/ (adverb): if not; or else. "Otherwise" gives the result of not doing what was just said; another sense is "in a different way".

items.question: Trong câu "Must I list every valid combination / arrangement?", từ "arrangement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Must I list every valid combination / arrangement?", what does "arrangement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: arrangement /əˈreɪndʒmənt/ (danh từ): cách sắp xếp. "Arrangement" gần nghĩa "permutation" (hoán vị, có thứ tự); "make arrangements" = thu xếp, chuẩn bị.
items.explanationEn: arrangement /əˈreɪndʒmənt/ (noun): an ordering of items. "Arrangement" is close to "permutation" (order matters); "make arrangements" means to plan or prepare.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there a local choice that is provably always safe (exchange argument)?", từ "provably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there a local choice that is provably always safe (exchange argument)?", what does "provably" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that can be proven
items.explanation: provably /ˈpruːvəbli/ (trạng từ): chứng minh được. "Provably correct/safe" = đúng/an toàn và có thể chứng minh; greedy chỉ dùng khi lựa chọn "provably safe".
items.explanationEn: provably /ˈpruːvəbli/ (adverb): in a way that can be proven. "Provably correct/safe" means it can be proven; use greedy only when the choice is provably safe.

items.question: Trong câu "Is there a local choice that is provably always safe (exchange argument)?", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is there a local choice that is provably always safe (exchange argument)?", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value passed to a function
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (danh từ): lập luận. "Exchange argument" = lập luận hoán đổi để chứng minh greedy đúng; trong code "argument" là đối số truyền vào hàm.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (noun): a line of reasoning. "Exchange argument" is a proof technique for greedy; in code an "argument" is a value passed to a function.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic trap: coin change with coins [1, 3, 4] and amount 6.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic trap: coin change with coins [1, 3, 4] and amount 6.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): cái bẫy. "Fall into a trap" = mắc bẫy; "the classic trap" = cái bẫy kinh điển nhiều người mắc phải.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a thing that tricks you. "Fall into a trap" means to be caught out; "the classic trap" is one many people fall into.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic trap: coin change with coins [1, 3, 4] and amount 6.", từ "amount" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic trap: coin change with coins [1, 3, 4] and amount 6.", what does "amount" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: amount /əˈmaʊnt/ (danh từ): số tiền cần đạt. "Amount" dùng với danh từ không đếm được (amount of money/time); với danh từ đếm được dùng "number of".
items.explanationEn: amount /əˈmaʊnt/ (noun): a total sum of money. "Amount" goes with uncountable nouns (amount of money/time); countable nouns use "number of".

items.question: Trong câu "When you cannot prove the greedy choice, fall back to DP.", từ "fall back to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you cannot prove the greedy choice, fall back to DP.", what does "fall back to" (phrase) mean?
options: chuyển sang phương án dự phòng
optionsEn: to turn to a backup option
items.explanation: fall back to /fɔːl bæk tuː/ (cụm từ): chuyển sang phương án dự phòng. "Fall back to/on X" = dùng X khi cách chính không được; danh từ "fallback" = phương án dự phòng.
items.explanationEn: fall back to /fɔːl bæk tuː/ (phrase): to turn to a backup option. "Fall back to/on X" means using X when the main plan fails; the noun "fallback" is a backup option.

items.question: Trong câu "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", từ "unless" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", what does "unless" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: unless /ənˈles/ (liên từ): trừ khi. "Unless noted/stated otherwise" = trừ khi có ghi chú khác; hay gặp trong tài liệu kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: unless /ənˈles/ (conjunction): except if. "Unless noted/stated otherwise" means except where marked; common in technical docs.

items.question: Trong câu "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", từ "note" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", what does "note" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: note /nəʊt/ (động từ): ghi chú rõ. "Unless noted" = trừ chỗ có ghi chú; "note that..." = lưu ý rằng...
items.explanationEn: note /nəʊt/ (verb): to mention specifically. "Unless noted" means except where marked; "note that..." means "pay attention to the fact that...".

items.question: Trong câu "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", từ "bracket" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", what does "bracket" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bracket /ˈbrækɪt/ (danh từ): dấu ngoặc. "In brackets" = trong ngoặc; ở đây là dấu [ ] (square brackets), còn ( ) gọi là parentheses.
items.explanationEn: bracket /ˈbrækɪt/ (noun): a symbol that encloses text. "In brackets" means inside [ ] here (square brackets); ( ) are called parentheses.

items.question: Trong câu "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Average case unless noted; worst case in brackets where it differs.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪfə/ (động từ): khác biệt. "Differ from X" = khác với X; tính từ là "different", danh từ là "difference".
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪfə/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ from X" means to be unlike X; the adjective is "different", the noun "difference".

items.question: Trong câu "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", từ "inverse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", what does "inverse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inverse /ˌɪnˈvɜːs/ (tính từ): nghịch đảo. "Inverse function" = hàm ngược; hàm Ackermann tăng cực nhanh nên hàm ngược của nó tăng cực chậm.
items.explanationEn: inverse /ˌɪnˈvɜːs/ (adjective): opposite in effect or order. An "inverse function" undoes another; Ackermann grows extremely fast, so its inverse grows extremely slowly.

items.question: Trong câu "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", từ "realistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", what does "realistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: realistic /ˌrɪəˈlɪstɪk/ (tính từ): sát thực tế. "Any realistic n" = mọi giá trị n có thể gặp ngoài thực tế; trái nghĩa "unrealistic".
items.explanationEn: realistic /ˌrɪəˈlɪstɪk/ (adjective): likely to occur in practice. "Any realistic n" means any value you would meet in practice; the opposite is "unrealistic".

items.question: Trong câu "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", từ "effectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", what does "effectively" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that works well
items.explanation: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (trạng từ): về thực chất. "Effectively constant" = trên thực tế coi như hằng số; nghĩa phổ biến khác là "một cách hiệu quả".
items.explanationEn: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (adverb): in practice, for all purposes. "Effectively constant" means constant for all practical purposes; the other common sense is "in a way that works well".

items.question: Trong câu "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", từ "constant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "α(n) is the inverse Ackermann function — at most 4 for any realistic n, so effectively constant.", what does "constant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: constant /ˈkɒnstənt/ (tính từ): không đổi. "Constant time" = thời gian hằng số O(1); "constant noise" lại là tiếng ồn liên tục.
items.explanationEn: constant /ˈkɒnstənt/ (adjective): not changing. "Constant time" means O(1); "constant noise" instead means noise that never stops.

items.question: Trong câu "Comparison-based sorting cannot beat O(n log n) in the worst case; counting and radix sort escape the bound only because they do not compare elements.", từ "escape" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Comparison-based sorting cannot beat O(n log n) in the worst case; counting and radix sort escape the bound only because they do not compare elements.", what does "escape" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (động từ): thoát khỏi. "Escape the bound" = không bị giới hạn đó ràng buộc; cũng gặp "escape a character" (thoát ký tự) trong lập trình.
items.explanationEn: escape /ɪˈskeɪp/ (verb): to get free of. "Escape the bound" means not being held by that limit; in code you also "escape a character".

items.question: Trong câu "Comparison-based sorting cannot beat O(n log n) in the worst case; counting and radix sort escape the bound only because they do not compare elements.", từ "bound" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Comparison-based sorting cannot beat O(n log n) in the worst case; counting and radix sort escape the bound only because they do not compare elements.", what does "bound" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bound /baʊnd/ (danh từ): giới hạn. "Lower/upper bound" = cận dưới/cận trên; "out of bounds" = vượt ngoài phạm vi (chỉ số mảng).
items.explanationEn: bound /baʊnd/ (noun): a limit. "Lower/upper bound" are the minimum/maximum limits; "out of bounds" means past the valid range.

items.question: Trong câu "Comparison-based sorting cannot beat O(n log n) in the worst case; counting and radix sort escape the bound only because they do not compare elements.", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Comparison-based sorting cannot beat O(n log n) in the worst case; counting and radix sort escape the bound only because they do not compare elements.", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "In the worst case" = trong trường hợp xấu nhất; đi cùng "best case" và "average case".
items.explanationEn: worst case /wɜːst keɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable situation. "In the worst case" pairs with "best case" and "average case" in complexity analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "Numbers are stored in binary, and bitwise operators work on each bit.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Numbers are stored in binary, and bitwise operators work on each bit.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔː/ (động từ): lưu trữ. "Be stored in binary" = được lưu dưới dạng nhị phân; danh từ "storage" = bộ nhớ lưu trữ.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔː/ (verb): to keep for later use. "Be stored in binary" means kept as bits; the noun "storage" means the place data is kept.

items.question: Trong câu "In JavaScript they convert operands to 32-bit signed integers first.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In JavaScript they convert operands to 32-bit signed integers first.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. "Convert X to/into Y" = đổi X sang dạng Y; danh từ "conversion" (sự chuyển đổi).
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into another form. "Convert X to/into Y" means to turn X into form Y; the noun is "conversion".

items.question: Trong câu "In JavaScript they convert operands to 32-bit signed integers first.", từ "signed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In JavaScript they convert operands to 32-bit signed integers first.", what does "signed" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be negative or positive
items.explanation: signed /saɪnd/ (tính từ): có dấu (âm/dương). "Signed integer" = số nguyên có dấu; "unsigned" = không dấu (chỉ ≥ 0).
items.explanationEn: signed /saɪnd/ (adjective): able to be negative or positive. A "signed integer" can be negative; an "unsigned" one is always zero or more.

items.question: Trong câu "n & (n - 1) works because subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit and every 0 below it: 12 = 1100, 11 = 1011, AND gives 1000.", từ "flip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "n & (n - 1) works because subtracting 1 flips the lowest set bit and every 0 below it: 12 = 1100, 11 = 1011, AND gives 1000.", what does "flip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: flip /flɪp/ (động từ): lật, đảo trạng thái. "Flip a bit" = đảo bit 0 thành 1 hoặc ngược lại; "flip a coin" = tung đồng xu.
items.explanationEn: flip /flɪp/ (verb): to switch to the opposite. "Flip a bit" turns 0 into 1 or 1 into 0; "flip a coin" means to toss it.

items.question: Trong câu "A bitmask of n bits can also represent a subset of n items: iterating mask from 0 to 2ⁿ − 1 enumerates all subsets.", từ "represent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A bitmask of n bits can also represent a subset of n items: iterating mask from 0 to 2ⁿ − 1 enumerates all subsets.", what does "represent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: represent /ˌreprɪˈzent/ (động từ): biểu diễn. "Represent X" = dùng để biểu diễn X; danh từ "representation" (cách biểu diễn).
items.explanationEn: represent /ˌreprɪˈzent/ (verb): to stand for. "Represent X" means to stand for X; the noun is "representation".

items.question: Trong câu "A bitmask of n bits can also represent a subset of n items: iterating mask from 0 to 2ⁿ − 1 enumerates all subsets.", từ "iterate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A bitmask of n bits can also represent a subset of n items: iterating mask from 0 to 2ⁿ − 1 enumerates all subsets.", what does "iterate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go through step by step
items.explanation: iterate /ˈɪtəreɪt/ (động từ): lặp qua lần lượt. "Iterate over/through X" = duyệt lần lượt X; danh từ "iteration" (một vòng lặp).
items.explanationEn: iterate /ˈɪtəreɪt/ (verb): to go through step by step. "Iterate over/through X" means to go through X one by one; the noun is "iteration".

items.question: Trong câu "A bitmask of n bits can also represent a subset of n items: iterating mask from 0 to 2ⁿ − 1 enumerates all subsets.", từ "enumerate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A bitmask of n bits can also represent a subset of n items: iterating mask from 0 to 2ⁿ − 1 enumerates all subsets.", what does "enumerate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enumerate /ɪˈnjuːməreɪt/ (động từ): liệt kê. "Enumerate all subsets" = liệt kê mọi tập con; danh từ "enumeration", liên quan "enum" trong lập trình.
items.explanationEn: enumerate /ɪˈnjuːməreɪt/ (verb): to list one by one. "Enumerate all subsets" means to list every subset; related to "enumeration" and "enum" in code.

items.question: Trong câu "Pitfall: 1 << 31 is negative in JavaScript because bit 31 is the sign bit; use >>> 0 to read the value as unsigned.", từ "pitfall" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pitfall: 1 << 31 is negative in JavaScript because bit 31 is the sign bit; use >>> 0 to read the value as unsigned.", what does "pitfall" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a deep hole in the ground
items.explanation: pitfall /ˈpɪtfɔːl/ (danh từ): cạm bẫy. "Common pitfalls" = các lỗi dễ mắc; "avoid a pitfall" = tránh cạm bẫy.
items.explanationEn: pitfall /ˈpɪtfɔːl/ (noun): a hidden danger. "Common pitfalls" are easy mistakes to make; you "avoid a pitfall".

items.question: Trong câu "A correct answer delivered in silence scores worse than a slightly slower one explained clearly.", từ "deliver" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A correct answer delivered in silence scores worse than a slightly slower one explained clearly.", what does "deliver" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to bring goods to a place
items.explanation: deliver /dɪˈlɪvə/ (động từ): trình bày, đưa ra. "Deliver an answer/a talk" = đưa ra câu trả lời / trình bày bài nói; nghĩa quen thuộc khác là giao hàng.
items.explanationEn: deliver /dɪˈlɪvə/ (verb): to present or give. "Deliver an answer/a talk" means to present it; the more familiar sense is bringing goods.

items.question: Trong câu "A correct answer delivered in silence scores worse than a slightly slower one explained clearly.", từ "slightly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A correct answer delivered in silence scores worse than a slightly slower one explained clearly.", what does "slightly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: slightly /ˈslaɪtli/ (trạng từ): hơi, một chút. "Slightly + tính từ so sánh" = hơi hơn một chút: slightly slower, slightly better.
items.explanationEn: slightly /ˈslaɪtli/ (adverb): a little. "Slightly + comparative" means a little more: slightly slower, slightly better.

items.question: Trong câu "Edge cases that catch people: an empty array or string, a single element, all elements equal, negative numbers, integer overflow (use BigInt past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), off-by-one bounds in binary search, cycles in graphs, and mutating the input when the caller did not expect it.", từ "overflow" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Edge cases that catch people: an empty array or string, a single element, all elements equal, negative numbers, integer overflow (use BigInt past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), off-by-one bounds in binary search, cycles in graphs, and mutating the input when the caller did not expect it.", what does "overflow" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˈəʊvəfləʊ/ (danh từ): sự tràn số. "Integer overflow" = tràn số nguyên; ngược lại "underflow" là tràn dưới.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˈəʊvəfləʊ/ (noun): going past the largest value. "Integer overflow" happens when a value exceeds the type's maximum; the reverse is "underflow".

items.question: Trong câu "Edge cases that catch people: an empty array or string, a single element, all elements equal, negative numbers, integer overflow (use BigInt past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), off-by-one bounds in binary search, cycles in graphs, and mutating the input when the caller did not expect it.", từ "mutate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Edge cases that catch people: an empty array or string, a single element, all elements equal, negative numbers, integer overflow (use BigInt past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), off-by-one bounds in binary search, cycles in graphs, and mutating the input when the caller did not expect it.", what does "mutate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (động từ): sửa đổi tại chỗ. "Mutate the input" = sửa trực tiếp dữ liệu đầu vào; tính từ "immutable" = không thể thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (verb): to change in place. "Mutate the input" means changing it directly; "immutable" means unable to be changed.

items.question: Trong câu "Edge cases that catch people: an empty array or string, a single element, all elements equal, negative numbers, integer overflow (use BigInt past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), off-by-one bounds in binary search, cycles in graphs, and mutating the input when the caller did not expect it.", từ "edge case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Edge cases that catch people: an empty array or string, a single element, all elements equal, negative numbers, integer overflow (use BigInt past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), off-by-one bounds in binary search, cycles in graphs, and mutating the input when the caller did not expect it.", what does "edge case" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: an unusual input at the limits
items.explanation: edge case /edʒ keɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp biên. "Handle edge cases" = xử lý các trường hợp biên như mảng rỗng, một phần tử.
items.explanationEn: edge case /edʒ keɪs/ (phrase): an unusual input at the limits. "Handle edge cases" means dealing with inputs like an empty array or a single element.

items.question: Trong câu "Interviewers reward visible reasoning.", từ "reward" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interviewers reward visible reasoning.", what does "reward" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reward /rɪˈwɔːd/ (động từ): đánh giá cao, thưởng. "Reward X" = khen thưởng / cho điểm cao cho X; cũng là danh từ "a reward" (phần thưởng).
items.explanationEn: reward /rɪˈwɔːd/ (verb): to give credit for. "Reward X" means to give credit for X; it is also a noun, "a reward".

items.question: Trong câu "Interviewers reward visible reasoning.", từ "reasoning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interviewers reward visible reasoning.", what does "reasoning" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reasoning /ˈriːzənɪŋ/ (danh từ): quá trình lập luận. "Visible reasoning" = cách suy nghĩ được nói ra cho người khác thấy; động từ "reason" (suy luận).
items.explanationEn: reasoning /ˈriːzənɪŋ/ (noun): the process of logical thinking. "Visible reasoning" is thinking you share out loud; the verb is "reason".

items.question: Trong câu "Read the constraints first: n ≤ 20 hints exponential, n ≤ 10⁵ hints O(n log n) or better.", từ "hint" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the constraints first: n ≤ 20 hints exponential, n ≤ 10⁵ hints O(n log n) or better.", what does "hint" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hint /hɪnt/ (động từ): gợi ý. "X hints Y" / "X hints at Y" = X gợi ý Y; cũng là danh từ "a hint" (lời gợi ý).
items.explanationEn: hint /hɪnt/ (verb): to suggest indirectly. "X hints (at) Y" means X suggests Y; it is also a noun, "a hint".

items.question: Trong câu "Read the constraints first: n ≤ 20 hints exponential, n ≤ 10⁵ hints O(n log n) or better.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the constraints first: n ≤ 20 hints exponential, n ≤ 10⁵ hints O(n log n) or better.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc. "Constraints" trong đề bài = giới hạn đầu vào (ví dụ n ≤ 10⁵); động từ "constrain" (ràng buộc).
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit placed on something. "Constraints" in a problem are the input limits (e.g. n ≤ 10⁵); the verb is "constrain".

items.question: Trong câu "Data structures are chosen by their fastest operation, and every choice is a trade-off worth naming.", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data structures are chosen by their fastest operation, and every choice is a trade-off worth naming.", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːθ/ (tính từ): đáng (làm gì). "Worth + V-ing" = đáng để làm gì: worth naming, worth saying; "worth $10" lại là trị giá.
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːθ/ (adjective): deserving of. "Worth + -ing" means deserving it: worth naming, worth saying; "worth $10" is about value.

items.question: Trong câu "The core patterns — two pointers, sliding window, prefix sums, hashing, binary search on the answer, heaps, interval sweeps, BFS/DFS, backtracking, greedy and DP — cover the vast majority of interview problems.", từ "vast majority" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The core patterns — two pointers, sliding window, prefix sums, hashing, binary search on the answer, heaps, interval sweeps, BFS/DFS, backtracking, greedy and DP — cover the vast majority of interview problems.", what does "vast majority" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: vast majority /vɑːst məˈdʒɒrəti/ (cụm từ): đại đa số. "The vast majority of X" = gần như toàn bộ X; trái nghĩa "a small minority".
items.explanationEn: vast majority /vɑːst məˈdʒɒrəti/ (phrase): almost all. "The vast majority of X" means nearly all of X; the opposite is "a small minority".

items.question: Trong câu "The master tables summarise the costs of every structure and algorithm in the course.", từ "summarise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The master tables summarise the costs of every structure and algorithm in the course.", what does "summarise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: summarise /ˈsʌməraɪz/ (động từ): tóm tắt. Anh-Anh viết "summarise", Anh-Mỹ viết "summarize"; danh từ "summary" (bản tóm tắt).
items.explanationEn: summarise /ˈsʌməraɪz/ (verb): to give the main points. British spelling is "summarise", American "summarize"; the noun is "summary".
